questiontext.text: Prototype for Go test-writing WAT questions. The learner submits a complete Go test file containing package main, an import of testing, and their test functions, but no main function. Each test case's extra field holds one full implementation variant, package main plus the function under test. The first variant is correct and its expected output is PASS. The rest are mutants and their expected output is FAIL. The template runs go test once per variant with the learner's file alongside it. Template parameters (JSON), all optional and space-separated: banned tokens that must not appear, required tokens that must appear, and limit countable bounds. The scan matches the same way the go_program prototype does, on comment- and literal-stripped source, and a violation stops the run before the first go test.
